subject: OPEN statement without the SHARING phrase and no SHARING clause in the file control entry (definition of sharing mode es
notes: kb/Work PB322 determination A LANDED (w1013m): the sharing mode established for a connector with neither a SHARING phrase nor a SHARING clause is one of the three standard modes chosen by the OPEN mode (INPUT = READ ONLY, otherwise NO OTHER), also for a LOCK MODE-only SELECT and for an OPEN whose only phrase is RETRY (both register no sharing, so SharedOpenAttempt falls through to the default). Witnesses: the golden's A/B/C/L connectors (the DOC-A.1-131 example statuses) and the clause-less reader that sees another connector's record lock. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/IO/FileRegistry.cs#Conflicts (FileRegistry.Conflicts was deleted; Table19.Conflicts is the one arbitration lookup) kb/Work PB670 LANDED (owner determination 2026-10-23, option (i)): at --std 85 the file sharing facility is not in effect (Annex A.4.7 is optional and A.4.1 makes its rules and I-O status values optional with it; the SHARING and LOCK MODE clauses are COBOL-2002 introductions). The implementor-defined default of 9.1.15 is the mode that restricts nobody: Table 19 is not asked, no file lock is taken against other run units, every OPEN of a file another connector holds answers 00 (OUTPUT beside a holder creates the empty file), a host refusal by a process outside the run unit answers 30, and 61 is never produced. One read: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility through FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect. Golden pb670_cobol85_no_sharing_facility (GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 gives the same statuses); SharingFacilityEditionTests pins every pair of opens in every organization at 85 and at 2002.
